stages.journal: Halla read Bram's books at the yard fire without saying a word, and then said one. Somebody is cutting in the old wood. Out the *Wardline gate* on the town's east side, follow the blazed pine and the boundary stones north-east into the deep stands. Whoever is out there posts men on the approach, and they will find you first.

The cut is real and it is old. A skid road dragged through moss that has not closed over, spars stacked where no honest wain could reach them, and a lean-to that has been slept in for more than one season. Break the camp and bring Halla the proof: the boundary stone they pulled up and used for a table.
